title: Reconciliation handling of prior non-approved decisions
objective: Repair the governance reconciliation engine so ARCH-WF-002 correctly emits and waives the stable decision-entry violation when the last prior decision exists but is not approved.
acceptance_criteria: collectReconcilableViolations emits decisions/entry:<STATE>/no-prior-approved-decision whenever a required state entry has no prior decision whose status satisfies the state-entry requirement, including when a prior decision exists with a different status.
The existing decision validator continues to reject an unapproved last prior decision when no active reconciliation waives the exact historical violation.
A valid ACR-sanctioned reconciliation can waive exactly the stable decision-entry key and no unrelated decision violations.
Deterministic tests cover zero prior decisions, prior changes_requested decisions, prior approved decisions, and an ACR-sanctioned reconciliation over the prior non-approved case.
Historical work-item timestamps and decisions are not rewritten.
Architecture v1.1 and all evidence/revision-binding rules remain unchanged.
The governance suite returns clean for COMPAT-CAD-009 when REC-COMPAT-CAD-009 is active and no unrelated violations are introduced.
No benchmark score increase is claimed.
non_goals: No change to lifecycle states or authorization roles.
No weakening of decision-order or re-verification policy.
No modification of application/CAD product behavior.
No architecture change beyond the narrowly bounded governance-rule correction; any architecture-controlled path still requires an ACR.
risk_assumptions: ARCH-WF-002 already defines this violation class as reconcilable.
The stable waiver key is already part of the governance contract and must remain unchanged.
CC009's historical defect is genuine bookkeeping order, not a product approval-substance defect.
evidence_requirements: Revision-bound governance tests covering the new case matrix.
Repository governance validation and deterministic suite.
Proof that existing reconciliation fixtures remain green.
